spec_family.name: Exterior Masonry Wall Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined condition assessment + prep + prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted exterior masonry wall surfaces (clay brick, CMU block, cast concrete, limestone, split-face CMU). Covers 7-point condition assessment (visual inspection, chalk test, adhesion test ASTM D3359, efflorescence scan, moisture test ASTM D4263, mortar joint assessment, crack mapping), surface prep (power wash 1500-3000 PSI — allowed on masonry unlike fiber cement, efflorescence neutralization with acid/TSP, chalk remediation, scrape/feather failing paint, crack filling, spall patching), state-driven primer selection (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, alkali-resistant spot prime on exposed bare masonry pH 12-13, acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion), finish coat application (spray_backroll primary — spray-only PROHIBITED on porous masonry, brush_roll fallback), optional elastomeric coating system for CMU/concrete (NOT on brick — moisture trap risk, NOT on limestone). SF-based with ITM_MASONRY_WALL. 5 masonry types (brick/CMU/concrete/limestone/split_face_cmu). QT2-QT4 (QT5 excluded). Flat/satin sheen. EPA lead-safe RRP for pre-1978 buildings (high activation probability — masonry structures commonly pre-1978). Single mobilization. NC sibling: SF_MASONRY_EXT_NC_v1.

includes: 7-point condition assessment per elevation (visual, chalk, adhesion, efflorescence, moisture, mortar, crack)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 buildings (HIGH probability on masonry — structures commonly pre-1978)
Power wash 1500-3000 PSI (dual purpose: cleaning + paint removal — allowed on masonry)
Efflorescence treatment (dry brush + acid neutralization on brick/CMU/concrete, phosphoric acid/TSP on limestone — NO muriatic acid on limestone)
Chalk remediation (chemical chalk removal on stubborn areas after power wash)
Scrape and feather failing/peeling paint with carbide scraper + 80-grit feather-edge sanding
Crack filling with elastomeric masonry filler (hairline cracks <1/4 inch, QT3+)
Spall/chip patching with cementitious compound (QT3+)
General surface repair (void fill, previous patch blending, QT3+)
Caulk assessment and replacement at masonry-to-trim junctions (polyurethane Class 25/50)
State-driven primer: chalk-binding (SS_EXT_CHALKING), alkali-resistant spot prime on bare masonry (SS_EXT_FAILING/PEELING), acrylic stain-block (SS_EXT_FAILING/PEELING)
Finish coat application — acrylic (1-2 coats by QT) or elastomeric (2 coats, CMU/concrete only, QT3+, flat only)
Interstage inspection, QT4 intercoat sand (220 grit), touch-up
Final walkthrough and touch-up
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based, catches scraping debris + overspray)
Hardscape protection (walkways, patios)
Ground cover below work zone (scraping debris containment, RP-specific)
Fixture and HVAC masking
Vehicle/driveway protection (spray only, RP-specific occupied home)
Spray equipment setup and cleanup
Site debris cleanup (scraping debris, paint chips, acid containers)
Customer walkthrough (RP-specific, occupied home context)

configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 excluded — masonry wall field is utilitarian surface. QT2=economy (single acrylic finish coat, light wash, acrylic only). QT3=standard (2 finish coats, full wash, acrylic or elastomeric). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand, premium materials, systematic inspection).
4 exterior RP states. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Worst-state-wins per v1. Per-elevation if conditions differ.
GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING (2.0x). Prep tasks only.
Drives texture modifier, cleaning restrictions, production rate. split_face_cmu is rough texture variant. Per-elevation if mixed masonry types.
Acrylic standard. Elastomeric for CMU/concrete crack-bridging (QT3+, flat-only). NOT on brick (moisture trap) or limestone.
spray_backroll primary — spray-only PROHIBITED on porous masonry. brush_roll fallback for small areas.
Flat or satin. Elastomeric is flat-only.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Masonry Wall Field Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable masonry wall field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim elements. Measured per elevation from PaintScope.
paintable_items.notes: Reuse from NC spec. Single paintable item covering all masonry types. masonry_type and texture modifiers adjust effective rates.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion. CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer. FAILING/PEELING require alkali-resistant on bare + acrylic stain-block.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_EXT_PAINTED_* after proper prep and coating.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Standard RP on sound brick. 2 acrylic finish coats spray_backroll, no prime.
Economy refresh on sound brick. Single acrylic coat.
Standard RP on chalking/failing brick. State-driven prime + 2 finish coats.
Full remediation on peeling brick. Heavy prep + alkali-resistant spot prime + acrylic prime + 2 finish coats.
Premium refresh on sound brick. Interstage sand + premium materials.
Standard RP on chalking/failing CMU block. No block filler needed (already applied in NC).
Elastomeric RP on CMU. Crack-bridging system. Flat sheen only. 1.50x coating modifier.
Fallback brush/roll method on sound brick. Smaller areas or occupied-adjacent.
Limestone RP. No muriatic acid — phosphoric acid or TSP for efflorescence. Lower wash pressure (1500-2000 PSI). Acrylic only (no elastomeric on limestone).
Lead-safe RP on pre-1978 brick. RRP containment + 2.0x prep modifier + wet scraping. Most expensive common scenario.

site_condition_rules.notes: Per-elevation. Scaffold common for masonry (heavy work at height).
Pre-1978 masonry buildings are HIGH PROBABILITY for lead paint.
MC >12% = STOP WORK. Active moisture (efflorescence, rising damp) = resolve source first.
Active/recurring efflorescence = STOP WORK until moisture source resolved.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Masonry RP typically runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (window/door casings). Power wash DOES NOT share pass with trim wash (different pressure requirements). Landscape/hardscape protection shared (U-004): first spec in elevation sequence owns setup.
coordination_notes: Caulk at masonry-to-trim junctions is THIS spec's responsibility (not trim spec).
Window/door protection during masonry work is owned by window/door RP specs.
Power wash containment is masonry-specific — heavy water volume requires proper drainage management.
Vehicle/driveway protection is shared RP zone with other exterior RP specs using spray.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (protection + equipment) -> RRP containment (if pre-1978) -> Assess (7-point per elevation) -> Prep (power wash + 24-48 hr dry -> efflorescence treatment -> chalk remediation -> scrape/feather -> crack fill -> spall patch -> surface repair -> dust cleanup) -> Caulk (assess -> remove -> apply) -> Prime (state-driven: chalk-binding OR alkali-resistant spot + acrylic stain-block) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage (QT3/QT4: inspect + QT4 sand + touch-up) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4) -> Final inspect -> Touch-up -> Protection teardown -> Equipment cleanup -> Site debris -> Customer walkthrough
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray-only on masonry (backroll mandatory). NO oil-based products. NO acid on limestone (use phosphoric acid/TSP). NO coating at MC >12%. NO elastomeric on brick or limestone. NO elastomeric at QT2. NO painting over active/recurring efflorescence. NO RRP without containment. NO elastomeric over failing previous elastomeric.
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time. Follow shade for optimal conditions. Assessment drives all downstream decisions per elevation.

relationships.notes: First exterior masonry RP spec. NC sibling: SF_MASONRY_EXT_NC_v1 (31 tasks, MSRY prefix). Key RP departures: power washing IS allowed (dual cleaning + paint removal), block filler NOT applicable, 7-point assessment module, state-driven primer selection, condition scale modifier, RRP high probability.

hard_stops.action: STOP — do not coat until masonry dries to MC <12%
hard_stops.description: ASTM D4263 moisture test. Masonry holds moisture longer than other substrates.
hard_stops.notes: Test at multiple locations per elevation. 24-48 hr retest after initial failure.

hard_stops.action: STOP — resolve moisture source before painting
hard_stops.description: Active/recurring efflorescence indicates ongoing moisture migration through masonry. Painting over active efflorescence will fail.
hard_stops.notes: Dormant efflorescence (past events, no active wetting) CAN be treated and painted.

hard_stops.description: Cracks >1/4 inch with visible displacement indicate structural movement. Outside painting scope.
hard_stops.notes: Cosmetic hairline cracks (<1/4 inch) are paintable with crack filler at QT3+.

hard_stops.description: Missing or deeply eroded mortar joints require masonry trade repair before painting.
hard_stops.notes: Minor hairline mortar cracking (<1/16 inch) is paintable.

change_log.author: SpecFactory Assembly Agent
change_log.changes: Initial spec.json assembly from 6 pipeline artifacts. QA Critic: PASS with 2 minor issues (worst-case stacking exceeds 4.0x on extreme combination, new PS keys need registry formalization). 48 tasks across 10 modules (7 owned MOD_MSRP_* + 1 shared MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT + 2 finish modules), 6 material systems (2 RP-specific primers + 1 reused NC primer + 3 reused NC finishes), 5 coverage profiles, 20 consumables, 10 compatibility rules, 7 factor modifiers with stacking partition, 4 round configurations, 8 protection zones, 5 adjacent surfaces, 16 PaintScope inputs, 10 variants, 1 paintable item (ITM_MASONRY_WALL SF-based reuse), 7 configuration dimensions, 4 hard stops, 6 proposed registry additions. First exterior masonry RP spec. Context prefix MSRP. Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish. spray_backroll primary (spray-only PROHIBITED). Power washing allowed (1500-3000 PSI — departure from FC siding RP). Block filler NC-only (not applicable RP). 7-point assessment module. State-driven primer selection. Condition scale GOOD/FAIR/POOR. 5 masonry types. Elastomeric on CMU/concrete only. RRP high probability on pre-1978 masonry. Caulk limited to masonry-to-trim junctions.
